fields.value: National Football League Alumni - Northern California Chapter (“NFLA-NC”); National Football League Alumni, Inc. (“NFLA”); and Food For Athletes, Inc. / Gridiron BioNutrients™ (collectively the “Company”).

quotes.text:
This Endorsement Agreement Addendum I (the “Addendum”) is made and effective November 7, 2017 ,
BETWEEN: National Football League Alumni - Northern California Chapter ( “NFLA-NC” ), a charitable corporation
organized under the laws of California, having its principal office at 1311 Madison Avenue, Redwood CA 94061;
National Football League Alumni, Inc. ( “NFLA ”) , a charitable corporation organized under the laws of Florida,
having its principal office at 8000 Midlantic Drive, 130 S., Mount Laurel, NJ. 08054.
AND: Food For Athletes, Inc. a corporation organized under the laws of California / Gridiron BioNutrients™, a
corporation organized under the laws of Nevada having their principal office(s) at 1147 N Roseburg CT, STE
A/B Visalia, CA 93291 (collectively the “Company” ).

The NFLA, NFLA-NC and the Company (collectively the “Parties”) agree that this Addendum I shall be affixed and be
enforceable under the terms of the Endorsement Agreement executed by the Parties on October 30, 2017.
This Endorsement Agreement Addendum I (the “Addendum”) is made and effective November 7, 2017 ,

payments.description: The Company must donate US$0.05 per Unit sold of Licensed Products within the Contract Territory, payable to the NFL Alumni Northern California Chapter, on a quarterly basis.
payments.conditionNote: No exact first payment date is stated; the clause ties payment to the first full quarter of the Agreement and to Units sold.

quotes.text:
C. A *donation of $0.05 per Unit sold of Licensed Products within the Contract Territory payable to the **NFL Alumni
Northern California Chapter. Donated amounts will be allocated and dispersed to the Northern California Chapter
beginning on the first full quarter [three (3) month period] of the Agreement and continue on a quarterly basis
thereafter for the term of this Agreement. Where the following per Unit conversion shall apply for the term of this
Agreement:
a. (1) Bottle of BlackMP Living
Water = 1 Unit
b. (1) 4oz bottle of BlackMP
Concentrate = 30 Units
c. (1) Bottle of Zezel Probiotic
Water = 1 Unit
d. (1) Bottle of Zayin Sports Water = 1 Unit
e. (1) Bottle Gridiron MVP™ Water= 1 Unit
f. (1) Bottle Gridiron CBD H20
Probiotics™ Water = 1 Unit
g. (1) 4oz bottle of Gridiron MVP™
Concentrate = 30 Units

ambiguities: SECTION FOUR. REMUNERATION says payments begin on the first full quarter of the Agreement, but does not state the exact first payment date.

payments.description: NFLA-NC must donate 15% of the above described proceeds to NFLA.
payments.conditionNote: The amount depends on the proceeds generated by the Company’s per-Unit donations; no exact payment date is stated for NFLA-NC’s donation to NFLA.

quotes.text: * The NFLA-NC will donate 15% of the above described proceeds to the NFLA.

ambiguities: The footnote in SECTION FOUR. REMUNERATION requires NFLA-NC to donate 15% of proceeds to NFLA, but does not state when that donation is due.
